change: Compute eight independent value-channel sums together; keep each sum in FP64 and the original observation order. Leave query/key scores and softmax unchanged. Scalar tail and explicit reference kernel remain.
numerical_gate: Bitwise reference/tiled component equality on fixed finite cases and identical errors/output preservation; trained export tolerance unchanged
performance_gate: At least 5% median paired batch-one p50 reduction; each saved seed improves in median; report all p99 results, with no more than 10% median paired p99 increase; no extra heap workspace or hot allocations
order: Alternate preserved baseline and candidate process order by trial+seed_index+workload_index; serial calls with sampling disabled
inputs: Same 32 validation windows and reference outputs as runtime_v1; verify hashes before each experiment
secondary: Repeat the frozen four-engine runtime comparison after acceptance; retain failed/negative outcomes
